# Bayou Sips
> Bayou Sips rents self-serve frozen drink machines for celebrations and events.

The official website is https://bayousips.com.

## Business Summary
Bayou Sips offers frozen drink machine rentals for event hosts who want a self-serve drink station. The business is based in Ponchatoula, Louisiana (Tangipahoa Parish). The website lets visitors compare three rentals, review flavor choices, and reserve an event date directly through the booking calendar at no charge. After reserving, owner Paula Meyers emails the customer a secure Stripe payment link for the full rental amount within 24 hours, due within 7 days.

## Hours
The online booking calendar (Cal.com) accepts reservations 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Phone callbacks and booking-response hours are Monday through Friday, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM Central Time. Outside those hours, customers can leave a message or send a Facebook message and Bayou Sips will respond the next business day.

## Rental Details
The Mini costs $175 and includes one self-serve cart, one single spout frozen drink machine, one flavor of the customer's choice, and 50 9-ounce plastic cups.

The Original costs $250 and includes one self-serve cart, one double spout frozen drink machine, two flavors of the customer's choice, 100 9-ounce plastic cups, and a white tent for all-day outdoor use.

The Deluxe costs $400 and includes one self-serve cart, one double spout frozen drink machine, four flavors of the customer's choice, 200 9-ounce plastic cups, and a white tent for all-day outdoor use.

## Flavor Menu
Fruity Favorites are Banana, Blue Raspberry, Cherry Bomb, Green Apple, Mango, Orange, Peach, Strawberry, Strawberry Banana, and Watermelon.

Tropical Escapes are Blue Hawaiian, Goombay Smash, Mai Tai, Pina Colada, Rum Runner, and Tropical Knockout.

Cocktail Classics are Feeling No Pain, Frose, Hurricane, Liquid Mary, Margarita, and Sangria.

Summer Refreshers include Summertime Lemonade.

Popular combos are Strawberry + Pina Colada, Mango + Margarita, Peach + Hurricane, and Blue Raspberry + Watermelon.

## Booking Flow
The website has Reserve buttons for each rental. Clicking one opens the Bayou Sips booking calendar (powered by Cal.com), where customers pick an available event date and share their phone number, event address, event type, guest count, flavor choices, and any notes. Reserving is free with no payment taken at this step. When the form is submitted, the reservation enters a pending state. Owner Paula Meyers reviews each reservation and sends a confirmation email once she accepts the booking, typically within booking-response hours (Mon-Fri 10am-8pm CT). After the booking is confirmed, Paula emails the customer a secure Stripe payment link for the full rental amount. Payment is due within 7 days of the link being sent. Card, Apple Pay, and Google Pay are accepted on the Stripe-hosted payment page. There is no deposit at booking.

## Direct Booking URLs
The three rental options each have a dedicated Cal.com event-type page that can be linked or shared directly:
- The Mini ($175): https://cal.com/paula-meyers-ezwktk/the-mini-package-175
- The Original ($250): https://cal.com/paula-meyers-ezwktk/the-original-package-250
- The Deluxe ($400): https://cal.com/paula-meyers-ezwktk/the-deluxe-package-400

All three event types use the same Cal.com username (paula-meyers-ezwktk), are free to reserve (no payment at booking), and are confirmed by email once owner Paula Meyers reviews and accepts the booking. Payment is collected after the reservation via a Stripe payment link emailed by the owner.

## What Customers Provide at Booking
At checkout the customer provides their event date and start time, event type (wedding, birthday, shower, graduation, corporate event, cookout, etc.), approximate guest count, flavor picks from the menu (1 for The Mini, 2 for The Original, 4 for The Deluxe), event address for delivery and setup, and a working phone number for day-of coordination.

## Booking Policy
Reserving an event date is free; there is no deposit at booking. Each reservation is reviewed by Paula and confirmed by email once she accepts the booking, typically within booking-response hours (Mon-Fri 10am-8pm CT). After confirmation, the full rental amount is invoiced via a Stripe payment link, due within 7 days. Customers are encouraged to book at least 7 days in advance. For shorter-notice events, customers can message Bayou Sips through the Facebook page and Bayou Sips will accommodate when calendar availability and logistics allow. If a customer has questions while waiting for booking confirmation, they should email bayousips01@gmail.com rather than rebooking.

## Important Unknowns
The website confirms Bayou Sips is based in Ponchatoula, Louisiana and lists two co-owner phone numbers (Paula Meyers at 225-268-6647 and Baileigh Vinson at 228-334-9854), but does not list a street address, a specific service area or travel radius, delivery fees, full cancellation terms, or a weather policy. Those details are confirmed by email after a booking is placed, or visitors can ask through the Bayou Sips Facebook page before booking.
